meta.name: SoundKey Gesture Map
meta.author: Krishita Sanjay Choksi
meta.principle: The same gesture means the same thing everywhere in the app. There are five short-press actions and five long-press actions, mapped onto the Flipper Zero's five-way pad plus Back. A user only ever has to learn ten gestures, and they never change meaning between screens. Long-press is a fixed threshold of 500 ms.

gestures.meaning: Move focus to the previous item; the new item is announced.
Move focus to the next item; the new item is announced.
Select / activate the focused item, or toggle a setting.
Go back one level, or cancel the current action.
Decrease the focused value, or move to the previous category/field.
Increase the focused value, or move to the next category/field.
Start or stop the screen's primary running action (e.g. begin/end a scan).
Jump straight back to the home menu from anywhere.
Announce where you are plus the gestures available on this screen (context help).
